text:
kevin_cs: Heads-up: Velori Capital wants an APAC demo tomorrow. Their e2e tests keep tripping rate limits in staging. Renewal flagged as at-risk if demo fails.
kevin_cs: Request: temp CIDR allow + header bypass + raise to 150 QPS for 2 hours (09:30-11:30 SGT). env=staging, cust=velori-cap, reason=partner-demo, renewal_risk=high
mina_ops: Can you confirm exact CIDRs and whether they need peered egress or just proxy header?
kevin_cs: CIDRs are 198.51.100.32/28 and 203.0.113.64/28. Primary plan: IP allowlist on staging peering. Fallback: X-Client-Org header value "Velori-Partner".
jude_net: I can push the peering rules. Will file NET ticket. Also recommend we pre-warm prefix/KV cache and raise connection pool size for that window.
jude_net: Config proposal:
```
staging:
  allow_cidrs: ["198.51.100.32/28","203.0.113.64/28"]
  header_bypass: {"X-Client-Org": "Velori-Partner"}
  temp_qps: 150
  window_utc: "2026-04-08T01:30:00Z/2026-04-08T03:30:00Z"
  pool_increase: 1.5x
  kv_warm_pre: "2026-04-08T01:00:00Z"
```
anya_se: Note on streaming: limit max_tokens to 400 to avoid long-lived streams hogging capacity. Set prefix_cache_ttl=600. Also enable model-fallback: small-llama for degraded latency under 500ms p99.
mina_ops: I'll create NET-9123 and OPS-6210, mark for manual CS-lead approval since >self-serve QPS.
kevin_cs: CS lead @oliver_cs verbally OK. I'll add him to tickets.
deploy-bot: Change request queued: NET-9123, OPS-6210. Scheduled prewarm at 2026-04-08T01:00:00Z.
jude_net: Executing KV warm and pool resize at prewarm time. Monitoring dashboard: https://observ.redwood.internal/d/velori-staging/demo-run
mina_ops: Tickets: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/NET-9123, https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-6210. Labels: temp-qps, apac-demo, customer-onboard.
deploy-bot: Allowlist applied to staging at 2026-04-08T01:05:42Z. QPS uplift will be active at 2026-04-08T01:30:00Z.
jude_net: Final switch completed at 01:29:55Z. Observability: 95th latency steady ~120ms, p99 spiked to 380ms for 30s then normalized. No errors.
kevin_cs: Great. I'll confirm with Velori and run through expected behavior and rollback plan.
anya_se: Post-demo action: collect traces for any >300ms calls, and capture a sample prompt set for eval to ensure model quality not degraded by cache/pooling changes.
kevin_cs: Thanks team  will update renewal tracker after demo. :thumbsup:
